Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from the third ODI. After taking the lead, Zimbabwe now find themselves in a precarious position as they need to win the next one if they have to keep the series alive. Sri Lanka on the other hand would be looking to extend their winning momentum and seal the series when these two meet at the same venue on July 8, 2017 at 0945 local (0415 GMT). Do join us for that game. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Before we leave you can switch tabs to catch all the action from the ongoing Test match at Lord's between England vs South Africa and then the 5th and final ODI between West Indies and India. Cheers!

Sri Lankan skipper, ANGELO MATHEWS starts by saying it was a fantastic effort from his boys. Continues they were under pressure after losing the first game but since then they have never looked back. Lauds Hamilton Masakadza's effort with the bat but is elated to have restrict them to 310. Credits his openers (Gunathilaka and Dickwella) and is short of words to describe their knocks. Ends up thanking Tharanga for taking them over the line and more importantly for the sacrifice he has made for his country as he has been sent up and down in the past few years.

Zimbabwe skipper, GRAEME CREMER feels that they DID NOT have enough runs on the board. Admits that they slowed down in the middle overs and could have got 350-360. Also, he says that they could have made a good fist of the score they eventually made but the dropped catches did not help.

MAN OF THE MATCH, DANUSHKA GUNATHILAKA is really delighted to get his maiden ODI ton and that too in front of his home crowd. Credits Dickwella for offering a perfect hand to him. Adds it was a good wicket to bat on and says they knew if they played their natural game they could get it easily.

Both the Lankan openers got out in quick succession but Upul Tharanga and Kusal Mendis stitched another 75-run stand to take their team over the line and take a 2-1 lead in the series. Zimbabwe did excellently well with the bat but failed to make an impact with the ball. Their bowlers were left hapless and their sloppiness on the field didn't help their cause either. Stay tuned as we bring you the captain quotes in a short while...

Sri Lanka have chased down a total in excess of 300 without breaking a sweat. Agreed it was a batting paradise here in Hambantota but you need application to do that. The Lankan openers, Gunathilaka and Dickwella started to hit from the word go and never let the visitors run away with the game. They smashed every bowler all around the park and in the process went on to break a couple of records as well, one being the marathon opening stand of 229 which happens to be the highest at this venue for any wicket. They got lives to which they took full toll of and thereby registered their maiden tons and laid a solid platform for the middle order to complete the remaining formalities.
FOUR! That is the game! A short ball, around middle and leg, Tharanga pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary! SRI LANKA WIN BY 8 WICKETS WITH 16 BALLS TO SPARE!
Landed outside off, short in length, Tharanga watches it go past his face.
SOLOMON MIRE is called back into the attack!
A long hop, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE. One more short ball. Tharanga ducks and the umpire signals a wide for height. Chatara looks to take his cap from the umpire but then smiles.
Another bouncer, Upul ducks again.

A short ball around middle and off, Tharanga looks to pull but miscues it. The ball goes high in the air and mid on rushes towards it but the ball drops down in no man's land.  Two more runs to the total.
Another bouncer, Upul ducks again.
WIDE. This is down the leg side, Upul lets it go.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
TENDAI CHATARA comes back for the final rites...
Gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish on middle, Tharanga swivel a touch and pulls it along the ground for another single.
Back of a length delivery on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish in length and around off, driven past covers for a brace.

Carl Mumba once again slips while delivering the ball and this time it's even worse. He removes the bandages around his knee and the physio comes running in. He takes him off the field. Let's hope he's fine...
Length delivery on middle, Mendis defends it on the leg side. Mumba slips after delivering the ball.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Mendis stands tall, keeps the bat skywards and ramps it down to third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Loopy ball around off, Tharanga cracks it through covers. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller around middle, Upual comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler who misfields and that allows them to take the single.
Flatter one around middle, punched off the back foot towards cover.
A bit short on middle, Mendis crouches low and pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Floats it up outside off, Tharanga goes back and forces it through covers for a single.
Tharanga stays back and steers it through point for a single.
The batsman manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Wide! Fuller and sprayed wide outside off, Utharanga leaves it alone.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Shortish on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Mendis looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
CARL MUMBA is back on!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for the second.
FOUR! This is dropped short and pulled to the mid-wicket fence with disdain.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
ANOTHER DROP! A short ball again, pulled towards mid-wicket. Chibhabha leaps but cannot hold on again! A single is taken.
DROPPED! Full and outside off, Tharanga comes down the track and lofts it over cover. Substitute Chamu Chibhabha leaps but is unable to collect.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! That is short and pulled magnificently over mid-wicket for a biggie!
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a brace again.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Stays inside his crease and lofts it over covers for a couple.

SIX! CRASH! Down the leg side, Tharanga flicks it effortlessly over square leg. Solomon Mire in the deep runs to his left, sticks out his hand but the ball evades him and lands full on the ropes. The umpires refer it upstairs for final confirmation and replays indicate that the ball bounced directly on the boundary line.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.

SAFE. Full and outside off, Tharanga pushes it towards cover and sets off for a single. However, the non-striker is not too sure and there is some confusion. Sikandar Raza at short cover dives to his right and fumbles a touch. Tharanga goes back and Raza fires a direct hit at the striker's end. Everyone gets excited but replays show that Tharanga has made it. Had Raza not fumbled, perhaps Tharanga would have been walking back.
A run out appeal against Tharanga is referred upstairs. It's a direct hit and it seems close...
Another short ball, Upul looks to pull and this time inside edges it onto his pads and the ball gets stuck there. An even bigger appeal follows for LBW. Need we say turned down?
A short ball on middle, Tharanga looks to pull but misses and is hit on the pads. There is an LBW shout but it is turned down.
Time for POWERPLAY 3. 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now. Sri Lanka look firm favourites in spite of that mini collapse.
Arrowed in on middle and leg, watchfully blocked.
Landed outside off, spinning away, pushed towards cover.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Dropped short, Upul immediately rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Solomon Mire keeps the batsmen to a single.
Around off, pushed through the covers for a couple. The stand is worth 10 from 9 balls now.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and around middle, Tharanga gets down and scoops it through fine leg. Short fine leg dives but in vain and the ball goes through! 66 more needed from 65 balls now.
Around middle and leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is a dart, around leg, pushed towards mid on for a quick run.
Delivered slowly through the air, around off, pushed towards cover.
A tad short outside off, spinning in, Mendis goes back and heaves it to long on for a single.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
A bit short on middle, Tharanga pulls it hard but finds the man at short mid-wicket.
UPUL THARANGA is the new man in, replacing Gunathilaka!

OUT! Soft dismissal! Both the Lankan openers are back in hut! Zimbabwe have made some sort of a comeback here. Nicely floated around middle, Gunathilaka backs away to dab it away but the ball hits his bat, bounces and then disturbs the stumps behind. Danushka can't believe but has to walk back. He gets a round of applause from his mates. Sr Lanka needed 74 from 73 balls.

Dropped by Mumba! Gunathilaka once again goes for the slog down the ground but didn't get any timing behind it. But much to his delight the fielder drops a sitter at long on. Such kind of day for the visitors.

SIX! Tonk! Loopy delivery around off, Gunathilaka gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it powerfully over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. There was a man stationed there but he could only watch it sail over him.

In the air... safe! Tossed up delivery around middle, Gunathilaka looks to sweep but gets a big top edge towards deep backward square leg. The fielder comes running in too much as the ball falls just short of him and then bounces over his head. Two taken.
Stays behind the line and tucks it towards short fine leg.
Also, SEAN WILLIAMS comes back into the attack! 82 needed from 78 balls.
KUSAL MENDIS is the next man in, replacing Dickwella!

OUT! Zimbabwe finally draw first blood! Waller is pumped up, but is it too late? Nevertheless, something for them to smile at. He bowls a full ball around middle, Niroshan Dickwella sits down to sweep it but gets a bit of top edge and Williams at backward square leg takes it above his head. Dickwella has to walk back but not before playing a blinder.

FOUR BYES! Nothing going Zimbabwe's way! Waller sends in a flatter ball on the stumps, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and so does Moor behind the stumps. The ball races away to the fence.
Looks to turn it through the leg side but fails to do so and is hit on the pads.
A bit short and stays low as well, Danushka backs away and punches it towards wide long off for a single.
Another one fired this time on the stumps, Dickwella drives it down to long on for a single.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Dickwella gets down to sweep but misses.
Comes down the track and works it towards square leg.
MALCOLM WALLER is back on!

Drinks taken! Sri Lanka are going pretty at the moment as both their openers have done a fabulous job so far. Both have registered their maiden tons and are taking their team over the line. They just need 89 from 84 balls and one would feel it's Sri Lanka all the way by the looks of things. Let's see if they manage to wrap it up soon or do we have some twist?
Slower length delivery on off, defended off the back foot.
Short and down the leg side again, DG looks to pull but gets it off the gloves towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Once again short, down the leg side, Danushka Gunathilaka pulls it off the back foot and the ball races behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
DG gets a bottom edge which goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Maiden ODI ton for Danushka Gunathilaka!

FOUR! What a shot to bring up the ton! It's a maiden one for Gunathilaka as well! Short ball on middle, Danushka swivels a touch and pulls it with his might in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. Removes the helmet, has his hands aloft and acknowledges the appreciations from everyone present.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards backward point.
SOLOMON MIRE into the attack!
A bit of flight around off, milked down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Waller drags the length short, Gunathilka immediately goes deep in the crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitches it on the stumps, defended into the ground.
Tossed up wide outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Backs away to cut but finds the man at cover.
Fuller on off, pushed back to Waller.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on the stumps, tucked towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Cheeky! Short and a bit of width given as well, Dickwella goes back, opens the bat face and runs it past short third man to pick up another boundary.
Comes forward and defends it down.
FOUR! 200 up for Sri Lanka! Tossed up delivery outside off, Gunathilaka  skips down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy leg break around middle, defended off the back foot.
Flat and outside off, Dickwella punches it straight to short third man who dives and stops.
Eased down to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, forced through point for a couple.
Maiden ODI ton for Niroshan Dickwella!

Now you can celebrate young man! A maiden ODI ton and that feeling is really special. He is absolutely delighted, roars in joy, punches his fist and just when he was about to raise his bat it slips but such is the mood that he winks saying no worries. The crowd is up on its feet and so are his teammates. Well played, Niroshan! Around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Hangs back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, Danushka looks to cut but gets an outside edge on the bounce towards short third man.
Goes back and tucks it through square leg for a single.

Floats it up around middle, Dickwella drives it down to long on for a single. He starts to celebrate as he raises his bat towards the dressing room. But hold on, he is still on 99 so there seems to be some miscalculation that has been happened.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Turns in sharply, Gunathilaka looks to dab it but misses and is hit on the glove.
Maks room and eases it past covers for a single.
FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, Dickwella sits down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. He is inching closer to his maiden ODI ton.
Appeal for an LBW! Too full on middle, Gunathilaka gets down to sweep but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Floats it wider outside off, Dickwella skips down the track and lofts it down to long off for a single.
Leg bye! Drifts it on the pads, Danushka misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Flattish on middle, defended on the leg side.
This one stays low, Dickwella stays leg side to play it through covers for a single.
Pushed quicker through the air around off, defended off the front foot.
Lunges forward and eases it down to long on for a single.
Stays in the crease and punches it through covers for one.
Slider around off, DG looks to cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up delivery, wide outside off, Dickwella square drives it past point for a single. This is now the highest partnership at this venue for any wicket.
Very full on middle, swept straight to short mid-wicket.
Goes back and plays with the turn towards the leg side.
Goes back, allows the ball to turn away, Gunathilaka pokes it towards backward point.
Dances down the track and drives it down to long off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Dickwella knows square leg and fine leg are inside the circle and hence he goes deep in the crease and scoops it over the infield to find the fence.
Fires it on middle, Dickwella looks to sweep but gets an under edge on the pads.
Fuller around off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Tossed up on the stumps, bunted back to Cremer who collects the ball and fires it back at the striker's end.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Shortish in length down the leg side, Gunathilaka pulls it past the man at short fine leg for a boundary.
This one turns in sharply, Danushka looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Lunges forward and pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Drops it a bit short and outside off, Gunathilaka camps back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Milked down to long off for an easy single.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Gunathilaka misses his flick. This is now the highest opening stand at this venue. Previous best was 164 between Dilshan and K. Perera.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh-pad.
Fires it on leg, worked towards the leg side.
Backs away and taps it towards point for a single.
Darted around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery around middle, zipping through the surface, Gunathilaka misses his tuck and is hit on the pads.
MALCOLM WALLER is asked to roll his arm over...
Fuller and stays a bit low, Dickwella makes room to punch but finds the cover fielder.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Once again in the same zone, a single taken.
Once again it's on the leg stump, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Makes room and drives it through covers for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and targets the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Presses forward and clips it through mid-wicket for another single.
Fuller outside off, Danushka pats it in the same region for one.
Floats it up outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
A bit short and stays low as well, cut towards sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around middle and leg, DG looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Floats it up outside off, pushed towards point.
Once again a full ball is driven towards long on for a single.
Eases this full down to long on for one. 150 up for Sri Lanka!
FOUR! Bang! Drops it a bit short on middle, Gunathilaka goes deep in the crease and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Danushka doesn't play at it.
Backs away a touch and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Stays back to this short ball and punches it straight to Solomon Mire at short extra cover.
Risky! Slower through the air around middle, Dickwella crouches low, opens the bat face and glides it towards short third man for a single. Had he missed, he would have been a goner.
ND has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Flighted delivery around off, Dickwella comes dancing down the track to flick it away but gets an edge towards point where the fielder dives all over the ball. It goes in the deep and a couple is taken.
Floats it up outside off, defended off the front foot gently.
Darts it on the pads, worked towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tosses it up around off, defended by coming forward.
Flattish around off, punched off the back foot towards cover.

FOUR! More runs! Once again Williams bowls a half-tracker and was asking to be hit. Gunathilaka doesn't miss out. Rocks back and pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket. Umpire Ian Gould ducks in time to get away from it.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Short and flat outside off, Dickwella camps back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Skips down the track and punches down the ground for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Danushka Gunathilaka!

Fifty up for Gunathilaka! He's played a wonderful knock here. He started to fire first but now has slowed down, pacing his innings really well. Tossed up on the stumps, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Very full on the pads, defended back to the bowler.
Slows it through the air around middle, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! That's flayed! Raza drops it short around middle and off, Gunathilaka camps back and punches it through extra cover for a boundary. Moves on to 49!
Fuller around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track and drives it wide of long off for a run.
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
On middle and leg, worked towards square leg.
WIDE. Landed outside leg, spinning further down, Gunathilaka misses his flick. Peter Moor behind almost does the perfect split as he slips.
Comes down the track and chips it towards the bowler but he has gone to his left and the ball is to his right. A single to long on.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
On middle, played straight to short mid-wicket.

MIX-UP, BUT SAFE. Dickwella pushes it towards cover and sets off for a single but then stutters. Gunathilaka calls him through and there is a chance of a run out. He dives into his crease but the throw is a bad one and Moor fumbles as well. Replays show that while diving, Gunathilaka's bat was in the air! So... a better throw would have had him.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Comes down the track but is beaten in flight. Looks to flick but gets a leading edge which does not carry to point.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers. Deep cover gets to his left and dives to pull the ball in and saves a run for his side. Three taken.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SIKANDRA RAZA is back!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. Could have been a game-changing over but....
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Connects with the flick shot this time and earns a single.
Now a MISSED STUMPING. It is darted down the leg side and Gunathilaka looking to flick, misses the ball and loses his balance. However, Peter Moor is unable to collect the ball.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off for a single.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. Landed outside off, Dickwella plays the reverse sweep but mistimes it. The ball goes straight to cover where Tarisai Musakanda is placed but he somehow puts it down going to his right.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
SEAN WILLIAMS is brought into the attack!
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Glorious shot. Tossed up outside off, Dickwella leans and drives this through the covers for a boundary!
Full and down the leg side, Niroshan looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! That is Dickwella for you. Full and outside off, Dickwella reverse scoops this wide of backward point for a boundary!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

Carl Mumba slips in his followthrough and seems to be in some pain. He is limping at the moment and the physio comes running in to attend him. Meanwhile, it seems like drinks has been taken. Good news for Zimbabwe, Mumba is alright and is set to resume...
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

WAS THAT A NICK? No review taken. ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN TIMED OUT. A short ball down the leg side, Dickwella looks to tickle it fine and gets it off something. The keeper dives to his right to take the catch and appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Cremer has a mini-conference with his team but no one is sure. Eventually, they are timed out. Oh dear... replays show that there was some glove!
Outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, defended from the crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle and leg, Niroshan sits down and plays the lap over square leg for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella!

FOUR! Half century for Dickwella and it has come in quick time! To think that he was a slow starter today. Full and outside off, Dickwella leans and drives it through the covers. The good thing in this knock has been the lack of risks.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushes at this one but there is no feet movement and he gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! JUST WIDE! A short ball down the leg side, Dickwella just helps it past the diving keeper to the fine leg fence!
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man for a run. Not a great opening over from the skipper.
More poor stuff on the menu, this is short and asking to be hit, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FIVE WIDES! Poorest ball of the over, darted down the leg side, Gunathilaka misses his flick. Peter Moor misses it as well and for a second Gunathilaka is fooled. Then he starts to run. But he does not need to as the ball races to the fence behind.
Full and around off, much better, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side again, Gunathilaka helps it with the turn through fine leg for a couple.
Goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
GRAEME CREMER brings himself on now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Pushes this through the covers for a single.
Full toss around off, watchfully pushed to cover.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a single.
There is a dog on the ground and the groundsmen are right behind him to move it out of the playing arena...
FOUR! Up and over! Full and straight, Gunathilaka comes forward and lofts it straight back over the bowler for a boundary!
Flattish around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
ND has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery around middle, nudged through the on side for a single.
Keeps it full again around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Fuller around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 signaled! Maximum 4 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circlet till the 40th over.
Shortish outside off, Dickwella dabs it towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! Wayward from the bowler! Sprays down the leg side, all Dickwella had to do was to put some bat on it. He tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
A it fuller outside off, Niroshan opens the bat face and pushes it towards the point fielder.
Shortish on middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella dabs it towards short third man for a quick single.
Length delivery on the pads, tucked straight to the man at square leg.
Darts it on middle, bunted back to Raza.
Bowls it full on leg, worked towards mid on for a single.
That stayed really low! Dickwella somehow manages to keep it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Floats it up around off, defended off the front foot.
Strays on the pads, clipped fine down the leg side for a single. Wanted the second one as well but the throw is quick to deny them.
Niroshan defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Picks it up so well! Good length delivery, on middle and leg, Dickwella lifts his front leg and dumps it towards backward square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off, Dickwella has got nothing to do with it.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg.
Leg bye! Length delivery, angling in on the pads, Danushka looks to work it away but gets it off the gloves towards fine leg. The umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Length delivery on middle, flicked through square leg for a brace.
Very full on the pads, nudged towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Around off, turning in a touch, Gunathilaka goes back and tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air around middle and leg, flicked towards the on side for another single.
Flighted delivery around middle, Danushka works it towards mid on for  a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball around off, ND comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower delivery around middle and leg, DG looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Fullish on middle, pushed towards mid on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Edged and through! On a length and skidding off the deck, it squares Dickwella up and as a result gets an outside edge down to third man. Carl Mumba in the deep puts in a dive but even that is not enough to save the boundary.
Short fine leg drops back...
FOUR! Superb shot! A length delivery on middle, Dickwella gets down, shuffles a touch and paddle scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Stays back and steers it through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Boundaries keep coming! Short and outside off, Dickwella dabs it past short third man to pick up another boundary to his name.
Darts it on the middle stump, flicked towards mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shortish around off, it stays a bit low as well, Niroshan hits it back to the bowler.
Wide! Flighted delivery down the leg side, Dickwella looks to sweep but misses. The umpire after taking his time stretches both his arms.
Fuller around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Starts off with a short ball around off, cut straight to the cover fielder.
Time for spin then as SIKANDAR RAZA is brought into the attack.
Stays back and steers it towards backward point for nothing.
